title: dyssodia setifolia var. radiata
intro: Dyssodia setifolia var. radiata, commonly known as 'Rays Dyer' or 'Golden Ray', is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Dyssodia setifolia var. radiata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. Its therapeutic actions include modulating immune responses, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant activity, primarily attributed to bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic compounds.
